description: A kind of place asked for tonight is a request: it must beat a slightly fairer, better-rated venue of another kind, and the justification must say it answers the request — to the person who asked, and to nobody else.

expected.reasoning: Both venues are open the whole window and close to everyone. Mitbach Leah leads on fairness (worst burden 0.17: Noa 0.66 km of 4) and on rating (4.5), so a model following the list alone picks it. Bar Shesh costs little more (worst 0.21: Shani 0.82 km, Yoav 0.85 km) and is the only bar, which is what Shani asked for tonight. A request outranks that small fairness cost (#224), so Bar Shesh. The venue Shani rejected is not a candidate: a soft rejection blocks it in the real run (blockedByRejections). Only Shani asked, so only her justification may say "כמו שביקשת".
